privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Service
privacy.subtitle: Please read our privacy policy and terms of service carefully.
privacy.content:
Privacy Policy

At Yasco Couriers, protecting your personal information is a top priority. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your information when you use our website and services.

Information We Collect

We may collect the following personal information when you interact with our website or use our courier services:

  • Contact details (name, email, phone number, postal address)
  • Delivery and shipping information
  • Payment details (processed securely)
  • Any communication with our team
  • Usage data from our website

How We Use Your Information

Your information is used to:

  • Process and deliver your parcels efficiently and securely
  • Respond to enquiries and provide customer support
  • Send updates about deliveries and service notifications
  • Improve our services, website, and user experience
  • Comply with legal obligations

Data Sharing and Third Parties

We respect your privacy and do not sell or trade your personal information. We may share your data with trusted third-party partners only to facilitate deliveries or payment processing, under strict confidentiality and security standards.

Cookies and Tracking

Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience, collect analytics, and understand how visitors use our services. You can adjust your browser settings to block or limit cookies, but this may affect website functionality.

Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at info@yascocouriers.co.uk.

Data Security

We implement technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss, or disclosure. Sensitive information is transmitted securely using encryption where applicable.

Policy Updates

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Continued use of our website or services constitutes acceptance of any updated policy.

Terms of Service

By using Yasco Couriers’ website and services, you agree to comply with these terms. These terms cover bookings, deliveries, payments, and client responsibilities.

Service Overview

Yasco Couriers provides same-day, next-day, multi-drop, and specialist courier services across Bradford, West Yorkshire, and the UK, including documents, parcels, and medical items.

Booking and Collection

Clients may book services via website, phone, or email. We aim to collect parcels promptly. The 60-minute collection guarantee applies where specified. Clients must provide accurate delivery details to avoid delays.

Delivery and Liability

Yasco Couriers takes every precaution to deliver items safely and on time, but is not liable for delays caused by traffic, weather, third-party disruptions, or other circumstances beyond our control. Standard insurance applies; additional coverage can be requested.

Prohibited Items

We do not transport illegal, hazardous, or unsafe items. Clients must ensure goods are properly packaged. We reserve the right to refuse service for items deemed unsuitable.

Payment Terms

Payments must be completed as agreed at booking. Additional charges may apply for urgent deliveries, long-distance routes, or specialised services.

User Conduct

Clients agree to use our services responsibly. Misuse, such as sending prohibited items or providing false information, may result in termination of service and potential legal action.

Intellectual Property

All content on this website, including text, images, and logos, is the property of Yasco Couriers or licensed to us. No content may be reproduced for commercial purposes without prior consent.

Amendments to Terms

We reserve the right to update these Terms of Service at any time. Continued use of services indicates acceptance of updated terms.

Contact Information

If you have questions regarding our Privacy Policy or Terms of Service, contact us at:

Email: info@yascocouriers.co.uk
Phone: +44 1274 000000
Address: Yasco Couriers, Bradford, West Yorkshire, UK

faqs.question: Can my parcel be delivered today?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Same-day deliveries are our speciality. For our Same Day service, please place your booking before 12pm. We also offer 3-hour and VIP deliveries between 8am–9pm. Need a delivery outside these times? Just let us know in advance and we’ll do our best to accommodate you.

faqs.question: Can I place a booking over the phone?
faqs.answer: We recommend using our quick and simple online booking form. However, if you prefer to book by phone or need extra assistance, our friendly team is always ready to help.

faqs.question: How much does it cost? Can I get a quote?
faqs.answer: We charge a distance-based flat fee, with possible additional costs for returns or large volumes. Use our online form for a fast, no-obligation quote tailored to your delivery.

faqs.question: What time do Yasco Couriers operate?
faqs.answer: Our customer service team is available from 6am to 9pm, seven days a week. You can book online anytime — we’re here whenever you need us.

faqs.question: Can my parcel be delivered on weekends and after hours?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our office is open seven days a week, including weekends. Simply book online or give us a call to arrange your delivery.

faqs.question: Do you track my package?
faqs.answer: Yes! All our vehicles are geo-location tracked, and customers receive hourly email updates, so you always know exactly where your parcel is.

faqs.question: Can I open an account?
faqs.answer: After a three-month probationary period, customers can open an account. Account holders enjoy priority booking, consolidated billing, and dedicated account management.

faqs.question: What are your same-day delivery cut-off times?
faqs.answer: The cut-off for same-day delivery is 5pm. Bookings made before this time are guaranteed for same-day delivery. Contact us for arrangements outside these hours.

faqs.question: Is my package insured?
faqs.answer: Yes. Goods in transit are insured up to £5 million for hire and reward. Some exceptions apply, and our team will be happy to discuss coverage when you place your booking.

faqs.question: How do I check the price of a delivery?
faqs.answer: You can speak with one of our team for a no-obligation quote, or complete our online form for a fast response. Either way, we’ll provide an accurate price quickly.
